overview.en: Dermatologic pharmacology: poison ivy and dermatitis treatments, topical glucocorticoids, drugs for actinic keratosis, sunscreens, psoriasis therapies (topical, systemic, biologic, phototherapy), acne products including isotretinoin and iPLEDGE, and burn products (silver sulfadiazine, mafenide).
overview.zh: 皮膚科藥理：毒藤與皮膚炎治療、外用糖皮質激素、光化性角化症用藥、防曬乳、乾癬療法（外用、全身、生物製劑、光療）、痤瘡用藥（含isotretinoin與iPLEDGE）、燒傷用藥（silver sulfadiazine、mafenide）。

points.en: Poison ivy: calamine, astringent/antiseptic wet compresses, colloidal oatmeal baths; topical steroids work best before blisters form; oral steroids for severe cases; diphenhydramine may aid sleep.
points.zh: 毒藤：calamine、收斂/抗菌濕敷、膠體燕麥浴；外用類固醇於水泡形成前效果最佳；嚴重者口服類固醇；diphenhydramine可助眠。

points.en: Dermatitis (atopic, contact, stasis) is epidermal inflammation; first-line moisturizer plus topical glucocorticoid; systemic immunosuppressants (azathioprine, cyclosporine, methotrexate) if refractory.
points.zh: 皮膚炎（異位性、接觸性、鬱滯性）為表皮發炎；首選保濕劑加外用糖皮質激素；無效時用全身免疫抑制劑（azathioprine、cyclosporine、methotrexate）。

points.en: Topical tacrolimus/pimecrolimus: burning, itching, sun sensitivity (protect from sun); tacrolimus specifically is linked to a higher risk of skin cancer/lymphoma and, in children, varicella zoster infection.
points.zh: 外用tacrolimus/pimecrolimus：灼熱、癢、光敏感（需防曬）；其中tacrolimus本身與皮膚癌/淋巴瘤風險上升有關，兒童使用則可能增加感染帶狀疱疹的風險。

points.en: Wear gloves for any topical medication or patch and wash hands before and after.
points.zh: 使用任何外用藥或貼片時戴手套，前後洗手。

points.en: Anti-inflammatory, antipruritic, vasoconstrictive; potency depends on concentration, vehicle and occlusion (occlusive dressings increase absorption).
points.zh: 抗發炎、止癢、血管收縮；強度依濃度、劑型與是否密封而異（密封敷料增加吸收）。

points.en: Absorption is higher on scalp, axilla, face, neck, eyelids, perineum; lower on palms, soles, back.
points.zh: 頭皮、腋下、臉、頸、眼瞼、會陰吸收較高；手掌、腳底、背部吸收較低。

points.en: Contraindicated with prior steroid sensitivity or current systemic fungal, viral or bacterial infection.
points.zh: 曾對類固醇過敏或目前有全身性黴菌、病毒、細菌感染者禁用。

points.en: Local effects: burning, dryness, skin thinning/atrophy, striae, purpura, telangiectasia, acneiform eruptions, hypopigmentation, infection overgrowth.
points.zh: 局部效應：灼熱、乾燥、皮膚變薄/萎縮、妊娠紋、紫斑、微血管擴張、痤瘡樣疹、色素減退、感染過度生長。

points.en: Systemic effects: growth retardation in children, adrenal suppression, Cushing syndrome, glaucoma, cataracts.
points.zh: 全身效應：兒童生長遲緩、腎上腺抑制、庫欣症候群、青光眼、白內障。

points.en: Apply sparingly in a thin film on cleaned skin with gloves; no dry occlusive dressing unless prescribed; avoid open areas unless prescribed.
points.zh: 戴手套、清潔皮膚後薄薄塗抹；除非醫囑勿用乾性密封敷料；非醫囑勿塗於開放傷口。

points.en: Drugs: diclofenac 3% gel (NSAID, up to 3 months), fluorouracil (2-6 weeks, sun sensitivity), imiquimod 5% (up to 4 months, also genital warts), ingenol mebutate, aminolevulinic acid.
points.zh: 藥物：diclofenac 3%凝膠（NSAID，最長3個月）、fluorouracil（2-6週、光敏感）、imiquimod 5%（最長4個月、亦用於尖濕疣）、ingenol mebutate、aminolevulinic acid。

points.en: Expected reactions: redness, burning, crusting, swelling; ingenol risk of severe allergy and herpes zoster.
points.zh: 預期反應：紅、灼熱、結痂、腫；ingenol有嚴重過敏與帶狀疱疹風險。

points.en: Lesions are premalignant (squamous cell carcinoma); other treatments: cryotherapy, curettage, excision, laser.
points.zh: 病灶為癌前病變（鱗狀細胞癌）；其他治療：冷凍、刮除、切除、雷射。

points.en: Organic (chemical) products absorb UV; inorganic (physical) products reflect/scatter UV.
points.zh: 有機（化學性）吸收紫外線；無機（物理性）反射/散射紫外線。

points.en: Use broad-spectrum (UVA and UVB) with SPF at least 15.
points.zh: 使用廣譜（UVA與UVB）、SPF至少15。

points.en: Apply at least 30 minutes before exposure (PABA or padimate O products 2 hours before); reapply every 2-3 hours and after swimming or sweating.
points.zh: 曝曬前至少30分鐘塗抹（含PABA或padimate O者需2小時前）；每2-3小時及游泳/流汗後補擦。

points.en: Avoid PABA if allergic to benzocaine, sulfonamides or thiazides; sunscreens can cause contact dermatitis/photosensitivity.
points.zh: 對benzocaine、磺胺類或thiazide過敏者避免含PABA產品；防曬乳可能造成接觸性皮膚炎/光敏感。

points.en: UV peaks 10 a.m.-4 p.m.; add hat, sunglasses, protective clothing.
points.zh: 紫外線於上午10點至下午4點最強；另戴帽、太陽眼鏡、穿防護衣物。

points.en: Topical glucocorticoids for mild disease; not on face, groin, axilla or genitalia (atrophy).
points.zh: 外用糖皮質激素用於輕度；勿用於臉、鼠蹊、腋下、生殖器（萎縮）。

points.en: Tazarotene (vitamin A derivative): apply in the evening to dry skin; irritation and sun sensitivity.
points.zh: Tazarotene（維生素A衍生物）：晚上塗於乾燥皮膚；刺激與光敏感。

points.en: Calcipotriene (vitamin D analog): 1-3 weeks to work; local irritation; rarely hypercalcemia at high doses.
points.zh: Calcipotriene（維生素D類似物）：1-3週見效；局部刺激；高劑量罕見高血鈣。

points.en: Coal tar: odor, staining, irritation, sun sensitivity, cancer risk at high doses.
points.zh: 煤焦油：氣味、染色、刺激、光敏感、高劑量致癌風險。

points.en: Keratolytics: salicylic acid can cause salicylism (dizziness, tinnitus, hyperpnea, psychological changes), so avoid large areas/open wounds; sulfur promotes peeling.
points.zh: 角質溶解劑：salicylic acid可造成水楊酸中毒（頭暈、耳鳴、過度換氣、精神症狀），故避免大面積/開放傷口；硫磺促進脫屑。

heading.zh: 乾癬：全身、生物製劑與光療

points.en: Methotrexate: GI effects, stomatitis, bone marrow depression, hepatotoxic (monitor liver function), teratogenic (wait 3 months after stopping before pregnancy).
points.zh: Methotrexate：胃腸反應、口腔炎、骨髓抑制、肝毒性（監測肝功能）、致畸胎（停藥後3個月才可懷孕）。

points.en: Acitretin: severe psoriasis only; teratogenic (two contraceptive forms starting 1 month before, continuing 3 years after), hepatotoxic, raises triglycerides, lowers HDL; avoid alcohol, vitamin A, tetracycline.
points.zh: Acitretin：僅用於嚴重乾癬；致畸（治療前1個月起使用兩種避孕、停藥後持續3年）、肝毒性、升高三酸甘油酯、降低HDL；避免酒精、維生素A、四環黴素。

points.en: Cyclosporine: immunosuppressant, nephrotoxic, for severe disease.
points.zh: Cyclosporine：免疫抑制劑、腎毒性、用於嚴重乾癬。

points.en: Biologics (TNF-alpha blockers and interleukin inhibitors: adalimumab, etanercept, infliximab, ustekinumab, etc.): screen for TB first; risk of serious infection, hepatitis B reactivation, lymphoma; no live vaccines; no BCG 1 year before/after.
points.zh: 生物製劑（TNF-alpha阻斷劑與介白素抑制劑：adalimumab、etanercept、infliximab、ustekinumab等）：先篩檢結核；嚴重感染、B肝再活化、淋巴瘤風險；不可接種活性疫苗；BCG前後1年不接種。

points.en: Phototherapy: coal tar plus UVB; psoralen with UVA (oral methoxsalen) raises skin cancer and aging risk.
points.zh: 光療：煤焦油加UVB；psoralen合併UVA（口服methoxsalen）增加皮膚癌與老化風險。

heading.en: Acne: topical agents and oral antibiotics
heading.zh: 痤瘡：外用藥與口服抗生素

points.en: Stepwise: mild = gentle cleansing and topical antimicrobials/retinoids; moderate = oral antibiotics and comedolytics; severe = isotretinoin; hormonal options.
points.zh: 階段性：輕度＝溫和清潔與外用抗菌/類視黃酮；中度＝口服抗生素與溶粉刺劑；重度＝isotretinoin；可加荷爾蒙療法。

points.en: Wash and dry skin before applying; wash hands after; keep away from eyes, nose, lips, mucosa, inflamed skin.
points.zh: 塗抹前洗淨擦乾皮膚；之後洗手；避開眼、鼻、唇、黏膜、發炎皮膚。

points.en: Benzoyl peroxide: drying and peeling; reduce frequency if severe irritation. Clindamycin/erythromycin: combine with benzoyl peroxide to prevent resistance. Dapsone topical.
points.zh: Benzoyl peroxide：乾燥脫皮；刺激嚴重時減少頻率。Clindamycin/erythromycin：與benzoyl peroxide併用防抗藥性。外用dapsone。

points.en: Tretinoin, adapalene, tazarotene: vitamin A derivatives, burning, peeling, UV sensitivity (SPF 15+); stop vitamin A supplements; adapalene benefits at 8-12 weeks, may worsen initially. Azelaic acid: stinging, hypopigmentation in dark skin.
points.zh: Tretinoin、adapalene、tazarotene：維生素A衍生物，灼熱、脫皮、光敏感（SPF 15以上）；停用維生素A補充；adapalene 8-12週見效，初期可能惡化。Azelaic acid：刺痛、深膚色者色素減退。

points.en: Oral antibiotics (doxycycline, minocycline, tetracycline, erythromycin, etc.) take 3-6 months to improve.
points.zh: 口服抗生素（doxycycline、minocycline、tetracycline、erythromycin等）需3-6個月見效。

points.en: Isotretinoin: severe cystic acne unresponsive to other therapy; highly teratogenic; stop vitamin A and tetracyclines.
points.zh: Isotretinoin：用於對其他療法無效的嚴重囊腫性痤瘡；高度致畸；停用維生素A與四環黴素。

points.en: Effects: dry lips/eyes/skin, nosebleeds, joint/muscle pain, reduced night vision, UV sensitivity, depression (stop if it occurs).
points.zh: 副作用：唇/眼/皮膚乾燥、流鼻血、關節/肌肉痛、夜視力下降、光敏感、憂鬱（發生需停藥）。

points.en: Check triglycerides before and during therapy; avoid alcohol.
points.zh: 治療前與治療中監測三酸甘油酯；避免酒精。

points.en: iPLEDGE: controlled central system ensuring no one starts therapy pregnant or becomes pregnant; strict rules for patient, prescriber, pharmacist, wholesaler.
points.zh: iPLEDGE：集中管控系統，確保開始治療時未懷孕且治療期間不懷孕；病人、處方者、藥師、批發商皆須遵守。

points.en: Spironolactone and oral contraceptives lower androgen activity; spironolactone is teratogenic and can cause hyperkalemia, breast tenderness, menstrual irregularity.
points.zh: Spironolactone與口服避孕藥降低雄性素活性；spironolactone致畸，可能高血鉀、乳房脹痛、月經不規則。

points.en: Silver sulfadiazine: broad antimicrobial (including yeast) to prevent sepsis; does not speed healing; apply 1/16-inch film and keep covered; does not cause acidosis.
points.zh: Silver sulfadiazine：廣效抗菌（含酵母）預防敗血症；不促進癒合；塗1/16吋薄層並保持覆蓋；不會造成酸中毒。

points.en: Silver sulfadiazine adverse effects: rash, itching, blue-green/gray discoloration, leukopenia, interstitial nephritis; monitor CBC/WBC and report leukopenia.
points.zh: Silver sulfadiazine副作用：皮疹、癢、藍綠/灰色變色、白血球減少、間質性腎炎；監測CBC/WBC並通報白血球低下。

points.en: Mafenide acetate: penetrates avascular tissue; carbonic anhydrase inhibition causes metabolic acidosis with hyperventilation; painful, so premedicate; bone marrow depression, hemolytic anemia.
points.zh: Mafenide acetate：可穿透無血管組織；抑制碳酸酐酶造成代謝性酸中毒伴過度換氣；疼痛故需先給止痛；骨髓抑制、溶血性貧血。

points.en: If hyperventilation occurs, notify provider, check ABG/electrolytes; if acidosis, wash off and hold 1-2 days.
points.zh: 出現過度換氣須通知醫師、檢查血液氣體/電解質；若酸中毒，洗去並停用1-2天。

points.en: Other products: bacitracin (first-degree burns only), povidone-iodine, chlorhexidine skin cleanser.
points.zh: 其他：bacitracin（僅1度燒傷）、povidone-iodine、chlorhexidine皮膚清潔劑。

critical_points.en: Topical steroid absorption is highest on scalp, axilla, face, neck, eyelids, perineum; safe on back, palms, soles.
critical_points.zh: 外用類固醇吸收最高部位：頭皮、腋下、臉、頸、眼瞼、會陰；背、手掌、腳底較安全。

critical_points.en: Topical steroids: thin film, gloves, no dry occlusive dressing, not on open skin; watch for atrophy, striae and systemic absorption.
critical_points.zh: 外用類固醇：薄塗、戴手套、不用乾性密封敷料、不塗開放傷口；注意萎縮、妊娠紋與全身吸收。

critical_points.en: Tacrolimus/pimecrolimus: protect from sun; risk of skin cancer/lymphoma.
critical_points.zh: Tacrolimus/pimecrolimus：避免日曬；皮膚癌/淋巴瘤風險。

critical_points.en: Sunscreen: SPF 15 or higher, broad-spectrum, apply 30 minutes before exposure, reapply every 2-3 hours and after swimming/sweating.
critical_points.zh: 防曬乳：SPF 15以上、廣譜、曝曬前30分鐘塗抹、每2-3小時及游泳/流汗後補擦。

critical_points.en: Salicylic acid toxicity (salicylism): tinnitus, dizziness, hyperpnea.
critical_points.zh: Salicylic acid中毒（水楊酸中毒）：耳鳴、頭暈、過度換氣。

critical_points.en: Methotrexate and acitretin are teratogenic; acitretin needs 2 contraceptives (1 month before, 3 years after).
critical_points.zh: Methotrexate與acitretin致畸；acitretin需兩種避孕（前1個月、後3年）。

critical_points.en: Biologics: TB screening before starting; no live vaccines; watch for serious infection.
critical_points.zh: 生物製劑：開始前篩檢結核；不可接種活性疫苗；注意嚴重感染。

critical_points.en: Isotretinoin: highly teratogenic (iPLEDGE), measure triglycerides before/during, avoid vitamin A and alcohol, stop if depression.
critical_points.zh: Isotretinoin：高度致畸（iPLEDGE）、治療前後測三酸甘油酯、避免維生素A與酒精、憂鬱時停藥。

critical_points.en: Tretinoin and other retinoids: use sunscreen SPF 15+, stop vitamin A supplements.
critical_points.zh: Tretinoin等類視黃酮：使用SPF 15以上防曬、停用維生素A補充。

critical_points.en: Silver sulfadiazine: monitor WBC; leukopenia (e.g., 3000/mm3) must be reported; it does not promote healing and does not cause acidosis.
critical_points.zh: Silver sulfadiazine：監測WBC；白血球低下（如3000/mm3）須通報；不促進癒合且不會造成酸中毒。

critical_points.en: Mafenide: metabolic acidosis with hyperventilation; premedicate for pain; monitor ABGs and electrolytes.
critical_points.zh: Mafenide：代謝性酸中毒伴過度換氣；先給止痛；監測血液氣體與電解質。

critical_points.en: Oral antibiotics for acne take 3-6 months to show benefit.
critical_points.zh: 痤瘡口服抗生素需3-6個月見效。

mnemonics.en: Retinoid rule 'No A, No Sun, No Baby': stop vitamin A, use sunscreen, avoid pregnancy (isotretinoin, acitretin).
mnemonics.zh: 類視黃酮三不口訣：不補維生素A、不曬太陽（要防曬）、不懷孕（isotretinoin、acitretin）。

mnemonics.en: Mafenide = 'Mafenide Makes acidosis' (carbonic anhydrase inhibitor); silver sulfadiazine = 'Silver Shrinks WBCs' (leukopenia).
mnemonics.zh: Mafenide＝造成酸中毒（碳酸酐酶抑制）；silver sulfadiazine＝白血球減少。

caption.zh: Box 44.1-44.2：毒藤用品與皮膚炎藥物。

stem.en: A client with psoriasis uses salicylic acid. Which finding suggests systemic toxicity?
stem.zh: 乾癬病人使用salicylic acid。哪項發現提示全身性中毒？

rationale.en: Salicylism causes tinnitus, dizziness and hyperpnea (not decreased respirations).
rationale.zh: 水楊酸中毒表現為耳鳴、頭暈、過度換氣（非呼吸減慢）。

stem.en: A client on silver sulfadiazine has which laboratory result requiring follow-up?
stem.zh: 使用silver sulfadiazine的病人，哪項檢驗結果需追蹤？

rationale.en: Leukopenia is an adverse effect; report to the provider.
rationale.zh: 白血球低下為副作用，需通報醫師。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A burn client receiving topical mafenide begins hyperventilating. What does the nurse suspect?
stem.zh: 使用外用mafenide的燒傷病人開始過度換氣。護理師懷疑什麼？

options.zh: 僅疼痛引起的呼吸性鹼中毒

rationale.en: Mafenide inhibits carbonic anhydrase; hyperventilation compensates for metabolic acidosis. Notify provider and check ABGs.
rationale.zh: Mafenide抑制碳酸酐酶；過度換氣為代謝性酸中毒的代償。通知醫師並檢查血液氣體。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Before starting isotretinoin, which laboratory test does the nurse anticipate?
stem.zh: 開始isotretinoin前，護理師預期哪項檢驗？

rationale.en: Isotretinoin raises triglycerides; check before and during therapy. A pregnancy test is also required under iPLEDGE.
rationale.zh: Isotretinoin會升高三酸甘油酯；治療前後都要測。iPLEDGE亦要求驗孕。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: The nurse would collaborate with the provider about isotretinoin if the client also takes which supplement/medication?
stem.zh: 若病人同時使用下列何者，護理師應與醫師討論isotretinoin處方？

rationale.en: Isotretinoin is a vitamin A derivative; additional vitamin A risks toxicity.
rationale.zh: Isotretinoin為維生素A衍生物；併用維生素A有中毒風險。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: For which body areas is it safe to apply a topical corticosteroid with minimal systemic absorption? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 外用皮質類固醇於哪些部位全身吸收較少、較安全？（複選）

rationale.en: Thick, poorly permeable skin absorbs less; axilla, eyelids, face, perineum absorb more.
rationale.zh: 較厚、通透性差的皮膚吸收少；腋下、眼瞼、臉、會陰吸收多。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with partial-thickness burns is using silver sulfadiazine. Which statement shows a need for further teaching?
stem.zh: 部分皮層燒傷病人使用silver sulfadiazine。哪項說法顯示需再衛教？

options.en: "It will speed healing of the burn."
"It is applied directly to the wound."

rationale.en: It reduces microbial colonization and prevents sepsis but does not improve wound healing.
rationale.zh: 它減少微生物定殖並預防敗血症，但不促進傷口癒合。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which teaching about sunscreen is correct? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些防曬乳衛教正確？（複選）

options.en: Apply a chemical sunscreen at least 30 minutes before sun exposure
options.zh: 化學性防曬於曝曬前至少30分鐘塗抹

options.en: Reapply every 2-3 hours and after swimming
Use SPF 15 or higher with UVA and UVB protection
Sun is strongest in the early evening

rationale.en: UV is strongest 10 a.m.-4 p.m., and frequent reapplication is required.
rationale.zh: 紫外線於上午10點至下午4點最強，且需頻繁補擦。

stem.en: A client is to begin a TNF-alpha blocker for severe psoriasis. What must be done before starting?
stem.zh: 病人將開始使用TNF-alpha阻斷劑治療嚴重乾癬。開始前應完成？
